verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report explicitly credits Ollama with hot-swapping models without restarting the server ([ollama-comm-4]). That is backed by first-party claims of running multiple models concurrently ([ollama-docs-17]) and a REST API for running and managing models ([ollama-gh-4]), with pull/rm adding models on the fly ([ollama-comm-5]). missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of model loading/unloading and switching behavior on a running server, and clarity on whether the concurrency claim applies to local serving rather than only the cloud plan.
